examples.en: Chocolate is my weakness.
examples.uz: Shokolad — mening ojiz tomonim.

examples.en: The weakness in the plan was obvious and nobody wanted to say it.
examples.uz: Rejadagi zaiflik koʻrinib turardi va hech kim buni aytishni istamadi.

examples.en: She won a singing contest.
examples.uz: U qoʻshiq tanlovida gʻolib chiqdi.

examples.en: The result was contested and upheld on every appeal.
examples.uz: Natijaga eʼtiroz bildirildi va har bir shikoyatda u oʻz kuchida qoldi.

examples.en: She is very artistic.
examples.uz: U juda badiiy didli.

examples.en: The artistic side was excellent; the finances were a disaster.
examples.uz: Badiiy tomoni aʼlo edi; moliya esa falokat.

examples.en: There's no quick fix for this problem.
examples.uz: Bu muammoning tezkor yechimi yoʻq.

examples.en: There is no quick fix, and everybody keeps looking for one.
examples.uz: Tezkor yechim yoʻq va hamma uni qidirishda davom etadi.

examples.en: How do you interpret this poem?
examples.uz: Bu sheʼrni qanday talqin qilasiz?

examples.en: The clause can be interpreted two ways, and they chose the convenient one.
examples.uz: Bandni ikki xil talqin qilish mumkin va ular qulayini tanlashdi.

examples.en: Wear sunglasses for eye protection.
examples.uz: Koʻzni himoya qilish uchun quyosh koʻzoynagi taqing.

examples.en: The protection exists on paper and nowhere else.
examples.uz: Himoya qogʻozda bor va boshqa hech qayerda yoʻq.

examples.en: A problem has arisen.
examples.uz: Muammo yuzaga keldi.

examples.en: Should any difficulty arise, nobody has said who to contact.
examples.uz: Biror qiyinchilik yuzaga kelsa, kimga murojaat qilishni hech kim aytmagan.

examples.uz: Tez orada uning yolgʻon gapirayotgani koʻzga tashlandi.

examples.uz: Maʼlumotlar toʻliq emasligi faqat keyinroq koʻzga tashlandi.

examples.en: He doesn't take criticism well.
examples.uz: U tanqidni yaxshi qabul qilmaydi.

examples.en: The criticism was fair, specific and completely ignored.
examples.uz: Tanqid adolatli, aniq va butunlay eʼtiborsiz qoldirilgan edi.

examples.en: Cite your sources in the essay.
examples.uz: Inshoda manbalaringizga havola qiling.

examples.en: The study everyone cites was never actually published.
examples.uz: Hamma havola qiladigan tadqiqot aslida hech qachon chop etilmagan.

examples.en: He works at a research institute.
examples.uz: U ilmiy-tadqiqot institutida ishlaydi.

examples.en: The institute has been renamed twice and reorganised three times.
examples.uz: Institut ikki marta qayta nomlangan va uch marta qayta tashkil etilgan.

examples.en: There was a dramatic change in the weather.
examples.uz: Ob-havoda keskin oʻzgarish boʻldi.

examples.en: There's been a dramatic fall in applications since the fee rose.
examples.uz: Toʻlov oshganidan beri arizalar keskin kamaydi.

examples.en: He grabbed my arm.
examples.uz: U qoʻlimni changallab oldi.

examples.en: He grabbed the chance and nobody else had even seen it.
examples.uz: U imkoniyatni changallab oldi, boshqa hech kim uni koʻrmagandi ham.

examples.en: Our team is top of the league.
examples.uz: Jamoamiz liga yetakchisi.

examples.en: They're in a different league and know it.
examples.uz: Ular butunlay boshqa ligada va buni bilishadi.

examples.en: Wrap the present in paper.
examples.uz: Sovgʻani qogʻozga oʻrang.

examples.en: The bad news was wrapped in three paragraphs of praise.
examples.uz: Yomon xabar uch xatboshi maqtovga oʻralgandi.

examples.en: She is very sensitive to criticism.
examples.uz: U tanqidga juda sezgir.

examples.en: It's a sensitive subject that keeps being handled carelessly.
examples.uz: Bu doim beparvolik bilan muomala qilinadigan nozik mavzu.

examples.en: The frequency of buses has increased.
examples.uz: Avtobuslarning qatnov chastotasi oshdi.

examples.en: The frequency of these failures has doubled since the change.
examples.uz: Bunday nosozliklarning takrorlanishi oʻzgarishdan beri ikki baravar oshdi.

examples.en: This period is termed the Golden Age.
examples.uz: Bu davr Oltin asr deb ataladi.

examples.uz: Ular tejamkorlik deb atagan narsa aslida xarajatning koʻchirilishi edi.

examples.en: Cotton is the main crop here.
examples.uz: Bu yerda paxta asosiy ekin.

examples.en: The crop failed for the second year, and nobody had any savings.
examples.uz: Hosil ikkinchi yil nobud boʻldi va hech kimda jamgʻarma yoʻq edi.

examples.en: Calculate the total cost.
examples.uz: Umumiy xarajatni hisoblang.

examples.en: Nobody had calculated what the delay would actually cost.
examples.uz: Kechikish aslida qanchaga tushishini hech kim hisoblamagandi.

examples.en: He has broad shoulders.
examples.uz: Uning yelkasi keng.

examples.en: There's broad agreement on the problem and none on the solution.
examples.uz: Muammo boʻyicha keng kelishuv bor va yechim boʻyicha umuman yoʻq.

examples.en: The film was way better than the book.
examples.uz: Film kitobdan ancha yaxshi edi.

examples.en: The real cost was way above anything that had been mentioned.
examples.uz: Haqiqiy xarajat tilga olingan har qanday miqdordan ancha yuqori edi.

examples.en: He knows right from wrong.
examples.uz: U yaxshi bilan yomonni ajratadi.

examples.en: Two wrongs were committed and only one was investigated.
examples.uz: Ikki nohaqlik sodir etildi va faqat bittasi tergov qilindi.

examples.en: The teacher engages all the students.
examples.uz: Oʻqituvchi barcha talabalarni jalb qiladi.

examples.en: Nobody had tried to engage the people who would have to use it.
examples.uz: Undan foydalanadigan odamlarni jalb qilishga hech kim urinmagandi.

examples.en: Snow in the desert is a rare phenomenon.
examples.uz: Choʻlda qor — kam uchraydigan hodisa.

examples.en: It isn't a new phenomenon; it's simply being counted now.
examples.uz: Bu yangi fenomen emas; u shunchaki endi hisobga olinyapti.

examples.en: I'm ashamed of what I said.
examples.uz: Aytganimdan uyalaman.

examples.en: Nobody seemed ashamed, which was the most troubling part.
examples.uz: Hech kim uyalmayotgandek koʻrinardi, eng tashvishlisi ham shu edi.

examples.en: We ship to all countries.
examples.uz: Biz barcha mamlakatlarga joʻnatamiz.

examples.en: The order was shipped to an address that had closed.
examples.uz: Buyurtma yopilib ketgan manzilga joʻnatilgandi.

examples.en: The story is about a slave who became free.
examples.uz: Hikoya ozod boʻlgan qul haqida.

examples.en: He'd become a slave to a process he had designed himself.
examples.uz: U oʻzi yaratgan jarayonning quliga aylangandi.

examples.en: To whom should I send the letter?
examples.uz: Xatni kimga yuborishim kerak?

examples.en: It's still unclear to whom the complaint should be sent.
examples.uz: Shikoyat kimga yuborilishi kerakligi hamon noaniq.

examples.en: The news alarmed everyone.
examples.uz: Yangilik hammani tashvishga soldi.

examples.en: What alarms me is how calmly everyone is accepting it.
examples.uz: Meni tashvishga soladigani — hamma buni qanchalik xotirjam qabul qilayotgani.

examples.en: He is enthusiastic about learning English.
examples.uz: U ingliz tilini oʻrganishga ishtiyoqli.

examples.en: Everyone was enthusiastic until somebody asked who would do it.
examples.uz: Hamma ishtiyoqli edi, keyin kimdir buni kim qiladi deb soʻradi.

examples.en: She couldn't hide her hurt.
examples.uz: U ranjini yashira olmadi.

examples.en: There was real hurt behind the politeness.
examples.uz: Xushmuomalalik ortida haqiqiy ranj bor edi.

examples.en: Learn at your own pace.
examples.uz: Oʻz surʼatingizda oʻrganing.

examples.en: The pace of change has left the rules far behind.
examples.uz: Oʻzgarishlar surʼati qoidalarni ancha ortda qoldirdi.

examples.en: Every household has a TV.
examples.uz: Har bir xonadonda televizor bor.

examples.en: One household in five here has no reliable water supply.
examples.uz: Bu yerda har besh xonadondan bittasida ishonchli suv taʼminoti yoʻq.

examples.en: I have absolute trust in her.
examples.uz: Men unga mutlaq ishonaman.

examples.en: There is no absolute answer here, only a choice between costs.
examples.uz: Bu yerda mutlaq javob yoʻq, faqat xarajatlar orasidagi tanlov bor.

examples.en: One company dominates the market.
examples.uz: Bozorda bitta kompaniya hukmronlik qiladi.

examples.en: One voice dominated the meeting and the quietest person was right.
examples.uz: Yigʻilishda bitta ovoz hukmronlik qildi va eng jim odam haq edi.

examples.en: The venue for the wedding is a big restaurant.
examples.uz: Toʻy oʻtkaziladigan joy — katta restoran.

examples.en: The venue was changed three days before and half the people missed it.
examples.uz: Joy uch kun oldin oʻzgartirildi va odamlarning yarmi uni topa olmadi.

examples.en: The company sponsors our team.
examples.uz: Kompaniya bizning jamoamizga homiylik qiladi.

examples.en: The event was sponsored by a company nobody wanted to name.
examples.uz: Tadbirga hech kim nomini aytishni istamagan kompaniya homiylik qildi.

examples.en: The annual festival takes place in May.
examples.uz: Yillik festival mayda oʻtkaziladi.

examples.en: The annual review has become a ritual with no consequences.
examples.uz: Yillik koʻrik hech qanday oqibatsiz marosimga aylandi.

examples.en: The investigation is still going on.
examples.uz: Tergov hamon davom etmoqda.

examples.en: The investigation took two years and named nobody.
examples.uz: Tergov ikki yil davom etdi va hech kimning nomini aytmadi.

examples.en: Sweep the floor, please.
examples.uz: Iltimos, polni supuring.

examples.en: The new management swept away everything, good and bad alike.
examples.uz: Yangi rahbariyat yaxshisini ham, yomonini ham supurib tashladi.

examples.en: My grandmother lives on her pension.
examples.uz: Buvim nafaqasiga yashaydi.

examples.en: The pension was promised, revalued and quietly reduced.
examples.uz: Nafaqa vaʼda qilindi, qayta hisoblandi va jimgina kamaytirildi.

examples.en: I regard him as my best friend.
examples.uz: Men uni eng yaqin doʻstim deb bilaman.

examples.en: The warning was regarded as alarmist until it proved accurate.
examples.uz: Ogohlantirish toʻgʻri chiqqunicha vahimachilik deb bilingandi.

examples.en: We visited a tropical island.
examples.uz: Biz tropik orolga bordik.

examples.en: Tropical diseases have been appearing much further north.
examples.uz: Tropik kasalliklar ancha shimolda paydo boʻlmoqda.

examples.en: My English is gradually improving.
examples.uz: Ingliz tilim asta-sekin yaxshilanmoqda.

examples.en: Standards slipped gradually, which is why nobody noticed.
examples.uz: Standartlar asta-sekin pasaydi, shuning uchun ham hech kim sezmadi.

examples.en: What criteria do you use to choose?
examples.uz: Tanlashda qanday mezonlardan foydalanasiz?

examples.en: The criteria were changed after the applications had been received.
examples.uz: Mezonlar arizalar qabul qilingandan keyin oʻzgartirildi.

examples.en: The shop discounted all winter coats.
examples.uz: Doʻkon barcha qishki paltolarga chegirma qildi.

examples.en: They discounted the warning because of who had given it.
examples.uz: Ular ogohlantirishni kim bergani uchun eʼtibordan soqit qilishdi.

examples.en: The trial lasted two weeks.
examples.uz: Sud jarayoni ikki hafta davom etdi.

examples.en: The trial lasted four weeks and settled nothing.
examples.uz: Sud jarayoni toʻrt hafta davom etdi va hech narsani hal qilmadi.

examples.en: They got married in a civil ceremony.
examples.uz: Ular fuqarolik marosimida turmush qurishdi.

examples.en: The dispute has been dragged through the civil courts for years.
examples.uz: Nizo yillar davomida fuqarolik sudlarida sudralib keldi.

examples.en: Let's narrow down the choices.
examples.uz: Keling, tanlovlarni toraytiramiz.

examples.en: The gap has narrowed, though not for the reasons they claim.
examples.uz: Tafovut toraydi, garchi ular aytgan sabablarga koʻra boʻlmasa ham.

examples.en: There is too much violence on TV.
examples.uz: Televizorda zoʻravonlik juda koʻp.

examples.en: The violence of the reaction surprised even those who caused it.
examples.uz: Munosabatdagi qattiqlik hatto uni keltirib chiqarganlarni ham hayratda qoldirdi.

examples.en: They adopted a little girl.
examples.uz: Ular kichkina qizni farzandlikka olishdi.

examples.en: The method was adopted everywhere before anyone tested it.
examples.uz: Usul uni hech kim sinab koʻrmasdan turib hamma joyda qabul qilindi.

examples.en: He has a stable job.
examples.uz: Uning barqaror ishi bor.

examples.en: The situation is stable in the way a stopped clock is accurate.
examples.uz: Vaziyat toʻxtagan soat qanday aniq boʻlsa, shunday barqaror.

examples.en: We put up decorations for the party.
examples.uz: Biz bazm uchun bezaklar osdik.

examples.en: The decorations went up in November and came down in March.
examples.uz: Bezaklar noyabrda osilgandi va martda olib tashlandi.

examples.en: She chaired the meeting.
examples.uz: U yigʻilishga raislik qildi.

examples.en: She chaired the committee for six years without ever raising her voice.
examples.uz: U olti yil qoʻmitaga raislik qildi va bir marta ham ovozini koʻtarmadi.

examples.en: We're travelling on a small budget.
examples.uz: Biz kichik byudjet bilan sayohat qilyapmiz.

examples.en: The budget was set before anyone knew what the work involved.
examples.uz: Byudjet ish nimani oʻz ichiga olishini hech kim bilmasdan oldin belgilangandi.

examples.en: My initial reaction was surprise.
examples.uz: Mening dastlabki munosabatim hayrat boʻldi.

examples.en: The initial estimate was out by a factor of three.
examples.uz: Dastlabki hisob-kitob uch baravar xato chiqdi.

examples.en: The project is funded by the government.
examples.uz: Loyiha hukumat tomonidan moliyalashtiriladi.

examples.en: The work was funded for one year and planned for five.
examples.uz: Ish bir yilga moliyalashtirildi va besh yilga rejalashtirilgandi.

examples.en: The bullet missed him.
examples.uz: Oʻq unga tegmadi.

examples.en: They had to bite the bullet and admit the project had failed.
examples.uz: Ular tishni tishga qoʻyib, loyiha barbod boʻlganini tan olishga majbur boʻlishdi.

examples.en: You can sample the food before you buy.
examples.uz: Sotib olishdan oldin taomni tatib koʻrishingiz mumkin.

examples.en: They sampled opinion among people who already agreed with them.
examples.uz: Ular fikrni allaqachon oʻzlari bilan rozi boʻlganlar orasida soʻrashdi.
